categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies the `sendall` wallet RPC input handling and validation.
categories.rationale: Prevents `sendall` from generating an invalid transaction that locks UTXOs and causes negative balances when duplicate inputs are passed. While the wallet rubric prioritizes user-visible reliability including wrong balances, this issue requires an explicit duplicate input list from the RPC caller, making the fix worthwhile but deferrable.
